title: An Act to Amend the Definition of "Transient Occupancy" in the Laws Governing the Maine Land Use Planning Commission (EMERGENCY)

summary.text: This bill changes the definition of "transient occupancy" in the laws governing the Maine Land Use Planning Commission to mean occupancy that does not exceed 150 days, rather than 120 days as in current law, in a calendar year.
